stem:
Three students made models to represent numbers. The models are shown.

Anne                              Kareena                              Zane

Which models represent the same number?

options.label: A
options.text: Anne’s model and Kareena’s model, because 1 hundred, 1 ten, and 10 ones is equivalent to 1 hundred and 2 ones

options.label: B
options.text: Kareena’s model and Zane’s model, because 1 hundred and 2 ones is equivalent to 12 tens

options.label: C
options.text: Anne’s model and Zane’s model, because 1 hundred, 1 ten, and 10 ones is equivalent to 12 tens

visual_elements: models showing base-ten representations by Anne, Kareena, and Zane
difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding of place value and equivalence between hundreds, tens, and ones across different representations.
